notes: Glossary sweep 2026-11-07: the law defines a closed fund only as one whose fund agreement says so (Joint Investment Trust Law s. 1); the meaning is the ISA investor guide's. Fix pass 2026-11-07: re-cited from the ISA's 2017 investor guide to the law: s. 1 defines a closed fund only as one whose fund agreement says so (p. 4), so the meaning comes from s. 53(א)(1) (p. 41, its units are listed for trading on the exchange) and s. 55 (p. 42, their price is set by the trading). 'A limited number of units' left the line: the law does not say it.

notes: Glossary sweep 2026-11-07: the guide calls it "מחיר היחידה" and the selling price "מחיר פדיון" (p. 6); the manager may add a one-off הוספה on the purchase. Fix pass 2026-11-07: re-cited from the ISA's 2017 investor guide to the law: s. 42(א)(2) sets a unit's price at the fund's purchase price under s. 43 divided by its units, and s. 43(א) has the manager compute it from net asset value (p. 35). 'At the end of every trading day' left the line: s. 43 does not say it.
